title: Free tutorial: Build a timeline from three logs
summary: Put a VPN log, Windows logs and a process export on one clock and star the events that tell the story.

next.title: Seminar 5: Incident response: ransomware, lateral movement and memory

script.intro: Welcome. Incidents are solved on a timeline. Here you put a VPN log, two Windows machines and a process export on one clock and read the night at Garnet Precision Engineering.
script.outro: Starred events become the timeline in your report. Seminar 5 takes this case from first alert to containment, ransomware and memory included.
steps: Read the setting so you know the company, the date and the time zone. Then open the evidence in the case folder.

Every log has its own format and its own idea of time, so first agree one clock. Here everything is UTC, and India is five and a half hours ahead. The merged timeline reads all four sources together, sorted by time. Narrow it to the window the alerts point at, then star the events that tell the story: the VPN login from an odd place, the first remote logon, the process that should not have started. The gaps matter too. A quiet hour in the middle is a question to ask, not a hole to ignore.
Starred events become the timeline in your report. Seminar 5 takes this case from first alert to containment, ransomware and memory included.
